# Orvio 0.38

- Many more titles now show an IMDb and Rotten Tomatoes score, and they appear faster: Orvio's rating service now has scores for about 53,000 films and series ready, with more Rotten Tomatoes scores added every night.
- Scores saved before this update are refreshed once, so you see the new ones straight away. Your choice to show or hide scores is kept.
- A title without a Rotten Tomatoes score checks again after a few days instead of a month.
